texts.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]发现了那些奇怪的矿物读数的源头。[From.GetName]是巨型宇宙舰船的坟场，这里的舰船残骸已经沉睡了几百万年。[Root.GetLeaderName]还说道，“真是太遗憾了，这些推进器损坏过于严重，仔细检测也不会有什么结果。”
texts.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has found the source of the odd mineral readings. [From.GetName] is a graveyard for gargantuan spaceships that have been resting there for millions of years. [Root.GetLeaderName] goes on and on in the debriefing about a "profound sadness that the rockets are too broken down for even careful examination to yield results."

texts.zh: 我们发现那些奇怪的矿物读数来源于一些数量不明，异常巨大且技术先进的太空船残骸。飞船部件的锈蚀情况表明这片残骸于大约2,380,669年前产生。现场的科研单位试图对这些舰船的推进器进行逆向工程，但因其破损过于严重而失败了。
texts.en: We have discovered that the source of the odd mineral readings are the remains of an unconfirmed number of abnormally large, technologically advanced spaceships. Material decomposition indicates an age of approximately 2 380 669 years. The science unit on site attempted to reverse engineer the vessels' rockets but failed due to their heavily damaged state.

texts.zh: 通过彻底的扫描，我们发现了[From.GetName]奇异矿石成分的成因。[From.GetPlanetMoon]是几十艘巨型太空船的坠毁地点，其船体之大远远超出我们的想象。它们建造的时间可以追溯到几百万年前。
texts.en: Thorough scans have revealed the cause of [From.GetName]'s odd metal composition. The [From.GetPlanetMoon] is the crash site of dozens of massive spaceships, larger than anything we could have ever imagined. Their construction dates back several million years.

label.zh: 至少这些材料还很有用。
label.en: At least the materials will be useful.

label.zh: 这些材料会派上用场的。
label.en: The materials will surely come in handy.
